name: tgdrive-app
description: 宿主与应用契约、两个 SDK、测试替身、应用源码和确定性打包工具。

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @tgdrive/page-sdk && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run sdk:check && vitest run && npm run test:pipeline
scripts.test:formats: npm run sdk:check && vitest run reader/formats
scripts.test:formats:browser: npm run build --workspace @tgdrive/page-sdk && playwright test --config tests/standalone/formats.config.ts
scripts.test:pictures:browser: npm run build --workspace @tgdrive/page-sdk && playwright test --config tests/standalone/readers.config.ts
scripts.test:shorts: npm run sdk:check && vitest run shorts
scripts.test:readers: npm run sdk:check && vitest run reader
